§aWhen basic hazmat isn't cutting it anymore.§f

The High-Performance Hazmat uses lead-reinforced cloth for 2.0 total RR across the set. Noticeable improvement over the basic and Advanced variants.

The Liquidator goes even further at 2.4 total RR, built from lead cladding, empty gas tanks, and High-Performance parts. It's the best protection you can get before PaA, but it comes with a pretty big catch.

§cWARNING:§f The Liquidator cuts your movement speed by 40%. Don't wear it for anything other than reactor work or short trips through contaminated zones.

§ePS:§f The Liquidator upgrades directly from High-Performance pieces, so don't skip that tier.
